items.title: Blake Hinson after his first preseason game with the Utah Jazz: "I can help however. I can go get coffee. I can maybe make a shot. I can talk to somebody. I can watch your dog. I just want to be a part of the program."
items.author: MrBuckBuck

items.title: Blake Hinson can really shoot it. Good size for a shooter too. That could land him a spot in the league. But has to do something else to lock in that standard roster spot eventually. Good to see him on the glass a little bit tonight.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
